characters.description: Young lighthouse keeper, about 17. Short dark-brown hair, amber eyes, a long red scarf, a navy duffle coat over a cream cable sweater, a brown plaid skirt, dark grey socks, brown lace-up boots.
characters.name: Mira

characters.description: The old lighthouse keeper, about 70. White beard, grey hair under a dark-green knitted cap, small round glasses, a brown scarf, a yellow-brown oilskin coat with dark-blue shoulder and elbow patches over a brown waistcoat with a watch chain, dark-blue trousers, black rubber boots, a brass lantern.
characters.name: Tomas

description: Mira and Tomas stand on either side of the great lamp, which is still dark. Mira pours oil from the can into the burner while Tomas watches; she asks her question and he answers. At the cut she is still pouring.

dialogue.line: Then you light it again. That is the whole job.
dialogue.speaker: char/tomas

heading: INT. LAMP ROOM - NIGHT

location.description: A round glass room at the top of the tower. The great lamp and its ring lens stand at the centre. The sea on all sides.
location.name: Lamp room

props.description: A dented tin oil can with a long spout and a brass cap.
The great lamp. A tall brass drum of ring-shaped glass prisms around a brass oil burner with a thick braided wick, on a round stone pedestal.

script:
Mira and Tomas stand on either side of the great lamp, still dark.
Mira pours the oil into the burner.
MIRA: What if it goes out?
TOMAS: Then you light it again. That is the whole job.
She sets the can down, strikes a match and lights the wick. The light grows in the lens.
MIRA: It's lit.
The beam reaches out over the sea.

look.grade: blue dusk shadows, warm lamp light, soft contrast
